name: Whole Tree Render
instruction: show the complete mature tree including root flare, trunk, crown and reproductive structures

name: Botanical Portrait
instruction: emphasize defining crown, trunk, bark and foliage while retaining species identity

name: Orthographic Front
instruction: exact front orthographic view, no perspective distortion

name: Orthographic Side
instruction: exact side orthographic view, no perspective distortion

name: Orthographic Rear
instruction: exact rear orthographic view, no perspective distortion

name: Top Canopy View
instruction: top-down crown geometry and branch distribution

name: Root System
instruction: complete roots or anchor interface showing support, storage and nutrient exchange

name: Trunk Study
instruction: trunk taper, transport tissue, growth rings or analogs, damage repair and branch joints

name: Bark Study
instruction: young, mature, damaged and repaired surface tissues in macro detail

name: Branch Architecture
instruction: primary, secondary and tertiary branch hierarchy and load distribution

name: Leaf or Collector Study
instruction: front, back, edge, juvenile, mature, seasonal and damaged states

name: Reproductive Structure
instruction: closed, opening, mature, pollinated and spent reproductive structures

name: Fruit or Storage Body
instruction: external form, cross-section, ripening and dispersal function

name: Seed or Propagule Study
instruction: seeds, spores, pods or packets, dispersal, germination and establishment

name: Internal Cross Section
instruction: protective, transport, support, storage and reproductive tissues

name: Growth Stages
instruction: propagule, juvenile, adolescent, mature, old-growth and senescent stages

name: Seasonal Variants
instruction: growth, reproductive, stress, dormant, damaged and recovery states

name: Native Habitat
instruction: natural population with realistic spacing, age diversity and climate interaction

name: Forest Composition
instruction: forest-scale role, understory relationships, spacing and age classes

name: Discovery Scan
instruction: centered scientific scan source with restrained contour illumination

name: UI Icon
instruction: strong isolated silhouette readable at 64 pixels

name: Scale Comparison
instruction: side view beside a simple adult human silhouette and one-meter bar, no text

name: Master Botanical Plate
instruction: whole tree, views, roots, trunk, bark, branches, leaves, reproduction, growth, variants, materials and habitat vignette

name: PSD Extraction Board
instruction: isolated full tree, canopy, trunk, roots, branch groups, foliage clusters, reproductive parts and silhouette reference
